description: Read lessons learned previously recorded in this workspace — including ones captured while working on OTHER projects. Call this before starting new work, when debugging something that smells familiar, or when the user asks what has been learned before. Optionally filter by project.

project.description: Only return lessons recorded against this project. Omit to get every lesson in the workspace (the cross-project view).

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to your active workspace.

name: list_lessons
